description: Election Commission - Mr. Gamini Weerakoon was Selected as the member of the Horana Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Horana Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for a local authority position, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy created by resignation. This falls squarely under Election-related matters as it concerns the electoral process and composition of a local government body.
